introHtml: Good Value badge ID holders deliver reliable, budget-friendly performance for organizations that need to badge large teams without sacrificing quality. These holders feature clear PVC pockets and durable attachment options like breakaway lanyards or metal clips, making them a practical choice for trade shows, offices, and warehouses. Choose from vertical or horizontal orientations and add your logo with screen printing or pad printing to keep your brand visible every day.
